name: AOBP Integration
description: Records an AOBP blood pressure measurement from a Uscom BP+ device directly into a REDCap survey, using the BP+ JavaScript SDK.

project-settings.name: Instrument that carries the AOBP controls
Instrument that uses the collapsible information panels
Set the device clock from this computer when it is out by more than this many minutes (blank = 5)
Show warnings on measurements that succeeded (the device retried and recovered). Off by default: they are recorded either way, and there is nothing for clinic staff to act on
Store the raw measurement XML as a file on the record (needs seated_raw_xml / standing_raw_xml file-upload fields)
Log every serial line to the browser console (troubleshooting only)
